meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 转为公众号排版，生成配图与标题建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常写公众号文章，想从 Markdown 一键生成精美排版
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat article HTML with images and title suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write WeChat articles and want to convert Markdown to styled HTML with images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将 Markdown 文章转换为微信公众号 HTML，生成文章图片、创建草稿、提供标题建议，并去除 AI 写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求将 Markdown 转换为微信公众号格式，或需要生成文章图片、创建草稿、获取标题建议时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章转成微信公众号 HTML。
say.note: Claude 会运行转换命令并输出 HTML。

say.text: 为这篇文章生成一个封面图。
say.note: Claude 会调用图片生成功能。

say.text: 帮我给这篇文章想几个标题建议。
say.note: Claude 会运行标题建议命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert Markdown articles to WeChat Official Account HTML, generate article images, create drafts, provide title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account format, or need to generate article images, create drafts, or get title suggestions.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown article to WeChat Official Account HTML.
say_en.note: Claude will run the conversion command and output HTML.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article.
say_en.note: Claude will call the image generation feature.

say_en.text: Suggest some titles for this article.
say_en.note: Claude will run the title suggestion command.
